Name: Squatch A Sasquatch for Stardew Valley
Author: DistractedDude
Description:
Squatch is a silly guy that says some of the oddest things a sasquatch would say. He lives in the forest but visits the mountains and beach from time to time. 

He has a story about him trying to make friends with the villagers that progresses at different heart levels. Originally they don't notice him no matter what he does and it leads to shenanigans.

He also mentions a Alien named Paul a lot. Paul is the next mod I am working on in my Cryptid Creature Collection. He is not included but has a few lines about him.

This mod is a smaller mod a part of a Group of mods I want to make called Cryptid Creature Collection. I also am working on a Loch Ness Monster and other things along those lines. I just wanted to put something I wanted to see into Stardew valley and hope you enjoy it too!

I am still working on this mod and it still is very buggy and is more of a preview version to show it before I continue working on it. He does get stuck sometimes and it's ok he resets every night. He was formatted after my Spheal mod so it does have a visual bug right now that conflicts with it but other than that it works fine.
